postBuildHooks.linux/*: sh -c 'ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd) && mkdir -p "$ROOT/build/bin" && find "$ROOT/cmd/desktop" -name pebblebase -type f -exec cp -f {} "$ROOT/build/bin/pebblebase" \; && rm -rf "$ROOT/cmd/desktop/cmd" "$ROOT/cmd/desktop/build" "$ROOT/cmd/desktop/web"'
